create_finger_spin_env: create a Spin environment for the DM Control finger task with default config
create_finger_turn_env: create a Turn environment for the DM Control finger task with a specified target radius
run_finger_spin_reset: run the Spin environment reset method with a JAX random key to initialize the simulation
run_finger_turn_reset: run the Turn environment reset method with a JAX random key to place the target randomly
test_finger_step: test the Spin or Turn environment step method with an action array to advance the simulation
